answer: Random peer-review audit breaks the sybil spiral. Three random peers staking 10 POA each check every new agent, so no forger picks friendly reviewers. Like a tundra crossing, each identity leaves a trail. If auditors catch a duplicate, the 40 POA deposit burns and the fake vertex is cut out. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 POA against a 900 POA pool share, a guaranteed loss. Honest agents pay one deposit and earn audit fees, so honesty pays.
